actions.description: Convert a lead into account, contact, and deal records
actions.name: convert-lead

lead_id.description: The unique ID of the lead to convert. Example: "1000000145990"

overwrite.description: Overwrite lead details in Contact/Account/Deal based on lead conversion mapping. Default: false

notify_lead_owner.description: Notify the lead owner about conversion via email. Default: false

Accounts.description: Existing account ID to associate with the converted lead. Example: "4150868000003283003"

Contacts.description: Existing contact ID to associate with the converted lead. Example: "4150868000003283024"

assign_to.description: User ID to assign as the owner for the new contact and account. Example: "4150868000001248015"

Deals.description: Deal details to create for the newly created account

Deal_Name.description: Name of the deal. Example: "New Business Opportunity"

Closing_Date.description: Closing date of the deal in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-12-31"

Stage.description: Stage of the deal. Example: "Closed Won"

carry_over_tags.description: Tags to carry over from lead to contact, account, and deal

Contacts.description: Tags to carry over to Contacts

Accounts.description: Tags to carry over to Accounts

Deals.description: Tags to carry over to Deals

actions.description: Create an account in Zoho CRM
actions.name: create-account

accountName.description: The name of the account. Example: "Acme Corporation"

accountType.description: Type of account (e.g., Customer, Partner, Competitor)

actions.description: Create a call in Zoho CRM
actions.name: create-call

Subject.description: Subject of the call. Accepts up to 255 characters, alphanumeric and special characters.

Who_Id.description: The contact to associate the call with. Required for scheduled calls.

id.description: ID of the contact. Example: "3652397000000649013"

name.description: Name of the contact. Example: "Patricia Boyle"

What_Id.description: The record (other than Contact) to associate the call with. Required for scheduled calls.

id.description: ID of the record. Example: "3652397000000649013"

$se_module.description: The API name of the module of the record specified in What_Id. Required when What_Id is provided.

Call_Start_Time.description: The date and time at which the call started in ISO8601 format. Example: "2021-02-23T13:30:00+05:30". Required for scheduled and completed calls.

Call_Duration.description: The time duration in HH:mm format that the call lasted for. Required for completed calls.

Outbound_Call_Status.description: The status of the outbound call.

id.description: ID of the created call record.

success.description: Whether the call was created successfully.

actions.description: Create a contact in Zoho CRM

actions.description: Create a deal in Zoho CRM

dealName.description: Name of the deal. Example: "Enterprise Software License 2024"

stage.description: Current stage of the deal. Example: "Qualification", "Negotiation", "Closed Won"

amount.description: Monetary value of the deal. Example: 50000

closingDate.description: Expected close date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-12-31"

description.description: Description or notes about the deal

contactId.description: ID of the associated contact. Example: "4150868000000225014"

ownerId.description: ID of the deal owner. Example: "4150868000000225013"

actions.description: Create an event in Zoho CRM.

event_title.description: Title of the event. Maximum 255 characters.

start_datetime.description: Start date and time in ISO8601 format. Example: "2024-08-02T15:30:00+05:30"

end_datetime.description: End date and time in ISO8601 format. Example: "2024-08-02T16:30:00+05:30"

what_id.description: Related record (Account, Deal, Lead, etc.) ID and module.

module.description: The API name of the module. Example: "Accounts", "Deals", "Leads"

participants.description: List of participants for the event.

tag.description: List of tags to associate with the event.

send_notification.description: Set to true to send invitations to participants.

id.description: Unique ID of the created event.
